meta.title: OpenCode Go
meta.description: OpenCode Go provider for DeepSeek Harness: live gateway catalog, per-conversation session header, usage

en.catalogRefreshing: Showing the last known catalog; a refresh is running in the background.
en.factsCached: Model metadata is from the last successful reading,
en.intro: OpenCode Go models come from the gateway itself, and every request carries a per-conversation session id.
en.keepAliveHint: How long a connection to the gateway is held between requests. Longer pauses in a conversation cost one handshake each; the timer restarts on every answer.
en.keyHint: Stored write-only in the Harness credential store under OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY.
en.keyPlaceholder: Paste the OpenCode Go API key
en.pinHint: Send the gateway name to one address to reach a closer edge. The name still goes into the certificate, so the address has to serve this name; an address that cannot be reached falls back to the system DNS.
en.pinInvalid: That is not an IPv4 or IPv6 address
en.pinUnavailable: The pin could not be read
en.quotaSeed: Allowances are the built-in snapshot, transcribed
en.refreshHint: How long requests and the model picker reuse one listing.
en.requestLogDebugHint: Pool events and full session ids. Otherwise sessions are truncated to 8 characters.
en.requestLogEmpty: No requests recorded. Turn the log on, then make a request.
en.requestLogHint: Per-request records for troubleshooting. Off by default; enabling it does not change what requests do.
en.requestLogMaxEntriesHint: 50 to 500; oldest entries are dropped first. Default 200.
en.requestLogPageHint: One row per request. The table scrolls; the filters stay put.
en.requestLogReuseHint: Share of recorded requests that reused a kept-alive connection, estimated from new sockets vs recorded requests.
en.updateApplying: Updating… (removing the old version, then installing the new one)
en.updateConfirmHint: This removes the running version first, then installs
en.updateIncompatible: The new version is incompatible with this DSH build; finish the update from the plugin manager page (a version exemption needs your explicit approval).
en.updateInspectRefused: The published target could not be verified, so the installed version was left untouched:
en.updateNoManager: This composition has no plugin manager, so the update cannot be applied from here; update the package from the plugin manager page.
en.updateNotBundle: The published target does not declare a DSH bundle; the installed version was left untouched.
en.updatePendingBuilds: Installation needs build-script approval; approve it on the plugin manager page, then retry.
en.updateRemoteMissing: The update service is not ready yet; choose Check again to retry.
en.updateRestart: Restart DSH to finish applying the update.
en.updateStopProfile: The running version cannot be removed without a restart; restart DSH first, then retry.
en.updateUnreachable: Could not reach the npm registry, so no version information was read; choose Check again to retry.
en.usageLocalHint: The gateway publishes quota percentages only; token counts are what this process actually spent.
en.usageSpendHint: models.dev rates xD7 the tokens the provider reported — an estimate, not a bill. On the subscription (Go) endpoints it is indicative only; only the metered (Console) endpoints make it reconcilable.
en.writeRejected: The settings write was rejected (the namespace was reloaded) — try again
